description: This source file defines a custom RuntimeException class, CallFailedRuntimeException, used to encapsulate details about failed Feign HTTP calls in the project. It includes logic to extract error messages from JSON response bodies of failed requests.

classes.name: CallFailedRuntimeException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception that represents failure responses from Feign HTTP client calls. It captures HTTP status and a developer message, extracting detailed error info from the response body if available.

methods.name: CallFailedRuntimeException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a FeignException and extracts relevant error details, including HTTP status and developer message.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Private static method that creates a detailed error message string from a FeignException, including status code, request URL, and response content.

methods.name: extractDeveloperMessage
methods.description: Private static method that attempts to parse the error response body as JSON to extract a 'developerMessage' or similar error detail for more informative exception messages.
